TITLE: You can't lift your ring finger?
NEXT: NEXT: Measure your reaction time with just a ruler!

EN.손바닥을 책상에 쫙 붙여요: Put your palm flat on the desk
EN.가운데손가락만 접어서\n마디를 책상에 대요:
Fold only your middle finger under
so its knuckle touches the desk
EN.다른 손가락을 하나씩 들어요\n(억지로 힘주지 마세요):
Lift the other fingers one at a time
(don't force it)
EN.약지만 꼼짝 안 해요!: Only the ring finger won't budge!
EN.가운데손가락을 펴면?: What if you straighten your middle finger?
EN.약지도 잘 올라가요!: The ring finger lifts just fine!
EN.손가락을 드는 줄(힘줄)은\n손등에 있어요:
The cords that lift your fingers (tendons)
run along the back of your hand
EN.약지 줄은 가운데손가락 줄과\n띠로 묶여 있어요:
The ring finger's cord is tied
to the middle finger's cord by a band
EN.가운데손가락을 접으면\n그 줄이 약지 줄까지 붙잡아요:
When you fold your middle finger,
its cord holds the ring finger's cord too
EN.그래서 약지 혼자서는\n못 올라가요:
So the ring finger
can't lift by itself
EN.엄지 · 검지 · 새끼는\n줄이 따로따로라서 자유로워요:
The thumb, index and pinky
have their own cords, so they're free
EN.아프면 바로 멈추세요!: If it hurts, stop right away!
